title: Rasmiy imtihon: gapirish qismi
goal_uz: Dars oxirida IELTS va Cambridge gapirish qismining tuzilishi va mezonlarini bilasiz, ravon gapirish strategiyalarini qo‘llaysiz, javoblarni sabab va misol bilan kengaytirasiz va notanish mavzuda tushib qolmasdan gapirasiz.

scenes.title: Gapirish imtihoniga tayyorgarlik
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda yozish imtihoniga tayyorlandik. Bugun gapirish qismi. Ko‘p o‘quvchi aslida yaxshi gapiradi, lekin imtihonda hayajonlanib, qisqa javob beradi yoki to‘xtab qoladi. Dars oxirida siz IELTS va Cambridge gapirish qismining tuzilishini va mezonlarini bilasiz, ravon gapirish usullarini qo‘llaysiz, javobni sabab va misol bilan kengaytirasiz va notanish mavzuda ham gapirishni davom ettirasiz. Uyga vazifa — to‘liq soxta gapirish testini yozib olish.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we prepared for the writing paper. Today it is the speaking test. Many learners speak well in class but give very short answers or freeze in the exam. By the end of this lesson you will know the structure, use fluency strategies, extend your answers and keep talking, even on an unfamiliar topic.
scenes.say_uz: Qaytganingizdan xursandman. O‘tgan safar yozish imtihoniga tayyorlandik. Bugun gapirish testi. Ko‘p o‘quvchi sinfda yaxshi gapiradi, lekin imtihonda juda qisqa javob beradi yoki qotib qoladi. Tuzilmani bilasiz, ravonlik usullarini qo‘llaysiz, javobni kengaytirasiz va notanish mavzuda ham gapirasiz.

scenes.title: Topshiriq turlari va mezonlar
board: IELTS Speaking: Part 1 interview · Part 2 long turn · Part 3 discussion
Fluency & Coherence · Lexical Resource · Grammar · Pronunciation

examples.t: In Part One, the examiner asks about familiar topics such as work and hometown.
examples.uz: Birinchi qismda imtihonchi ish va tug‘ilgan shahar kabi tanish mavzular haqida so‘raydi.

examples.t: In Part Two, you speak alone for one to two minutes after a minute of preparation.
examples.uz: Ikkinchi qismda bir daqiqa tayyorlanib, bir-ikki daqiqa yolg‘iz gapirasiz.

examples.t: In Part Three, the questions are more abstract and need opinions.
examples.uz: Uchinchi qismda savollar mavhumroq bo‘lib, fikr talab qiladi.

scenes.say_native: IELTS gapirish qismi uch bosqichdan iborat va taxminan o‘n bir-o‘n to‘rt daqiqa davom etadi. Birinchi qismda imtihonchi ish, uy, qiziqishlar kabi tanish mavzularda savol beradi. Ikkinchi qismda sizga kartochka beriladi, bir daqiqa tayyorlanasiz va bir-ikki daqiqa to‘xtamasdan gapirasiz. Uchinchi qismda savollar mavhumroq: jamiyat, kelajak, sabab va oqibat. Mezonlar to‘rtta: ravonlik va izchillik, lug‘at, grammatika va talaffuz. Cambridge C1 Advanced da esa nomzod odatda sherik bilan juft bo‘lib gapiradi, shuning uchun suhbatni birgalikda yuritish ham baholanadi. TOEFL formatlari yangilanib turadi, shu sababli rasmiy saytni tekshiring.
scenes.say: IELTS Speaking has three parts and lasts about eleven to fourteen minutes. In Part One, the examiner asks about familiar topics. In Part Two, you get a cue card, one minute to prepare, and then speak for one to two minutes. In Part Three, the questions are more abstract. Four criteria apply: fluency and coherence, vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation.
scenes.say_uz: IELTS Speaking uch qismdan iborat va taxminan o‘n bir-o‘n to‘rt daqiqa davom etadi. Birinchi qismda tanish mavzular, ikkinchisida kartochka, bir daqiqa tayyorgarlik va bir-ikki daqiqa nutq, uchinchisida mavhumroq savollar. To‘rt mezon: ravonlik, lug‘at, grammatika va talaffuz.

scenes.title: Xato: mezonlar haqida noto‘g‘ri tasavvur

examples.t: Examiners want clear speech, not a British or American accent.
examples.uz: Imtihonchilar ingliz yoki amerika aksentini emas, tushunarli nutqni xohlaydi.

examples.t: Natural vocabulary scores higher than rare words used wrongly.
examples.uz: Tabiiy lug‘at noto‘g‘ri ishlatilgan noyob so‘zlardan yuqori baholanadi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi xato — mukammal aksent kerak deb o‘ylash. Imtihonchi sizdan ingliz yoki amerika aksentini emas, aniq va tushunarli talaffuzni, to‘g‘ri urg‘u va ohangni kutadi. Ikkinchi xato — qiyin so‘zlarni zo‘rlab ishlatish. Noto‘g‘ri ishlatilgan noyob so‘z ballni tushiradi, tabiiy birikma esa oshiradi. Uchinchi xato — yodlangan javoblarni aytish. Imtihonchi buni sezadi va yodlangan nutq ballga hisoblanmaydi. O‘zbek o‘quvchilarida yana bir odat bor: javobni „ha“ yoki „yo‘q“ bilan tugatish, chunki odob uchun ortiqcha gapirmaslik fazilat. Imtihonda esa teskarisi: ko‘proq gapirish ko‘proq ball imkonini beradi.
scenes.say: The first myth is that you need a perfect accent. Examiners want clear speech with sensible stress and intonation, not a particular accent. The second is forcing difficult words. A rare word used wrongly costs marks, while natural collocations earn them. The third is reciting memorised answers, which examiners detect, and they do not count it as real language.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi xato — mukammal aksent kerak deb o‘ylash. Imtihonchi aniq nutq, to‘g‘ri urg‘u va ohangni xohlaydi. Ikkinchi xato — qiyin so‘zlarni zo‘rlab ishlatish. Uchinchi xato — yodlangan javoblar, imtihonchi buni sezadi va ball bermaydi.

scenes.title: Mashq: Part 1 savoli
board: Examiner: Do you prefer to spend your free time indoors or outdoors?
scenes.say_native: Imtihonchi so‘raydi: bo‘sh vaqtingizni uyda yoki ko‘chada o‘tkazishni afzal ko‘rasizmi? O‘n besh-yigirma soniya ichida javob bering. Faqat bir so‘z bilan emas, to‘liq javob bering. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: The examiner asks: do you prefer to spend your free time indoors or outdoors? Answer in fifteen to twenty seconds. Give a full answer, not just one word.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihonchi so‘raydi: bo‘sh vaqtingizni uyda yoki ko‘chada o‘tkazishni afzal ko‘rasizmi? O‘n besh-yigirma soniyada to‘liq javob bering.

scenes.title: Javob: to‘liq javob namunasi

examples.t: I would say outdoors, because after a day at a desk I need fresh air.
examples.uz: Ko‘chada, deyman, chunki kun bo‘yi stolda o‘tirgandan keyin toza havo kerak.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „I would say outdoors, mostly. After a full day at a desk I need fresh air, so at weekends I usually go walking in the hills with friends. That said, in winter I stay in and read.“ Tuzilishga e’tibor bering: javob, sabab, misol, qo‘shimcha qarama-qarshilik. „I would say“ — deyman, yumshoq boshlanish. „That said“ — shunday bo‘lsa-da. Agar siz „outdoors“ deb to‘xtasangiz, bu qisqa javob bo‘lardi. Sizning javobingizda kamida bitta sabab bo‘lsa, topshiriq yaxshi bajarilgan.
scenes.say: A model answer. I would say outdoors, mostly. After a full day at a desk I need fresh air, so at weekends I usually go walking in the hills with friends. That said, in winter I tend to stay in and read. Notice the structure: answer, reason, example and a small contrast.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. Asosan ko‘chada, deyman. Kun bo‘yi stolda o‘tirgandan keyin toza havo kerak, shuning uchun dam olish kunlari odatda do‘stlar bilan tog‘da sayr qilaman. Shunday bo‘lsa-da, qishda uyda kitob o‘qiyman. Tuzilish: javob, sabab, misol va kichik qarama-qarshilik.

scenes.title: Ravonlik strategiyalari
board: Use natural fillers: well · let me think · actually
Rephrase if stuck: in other words…

examples.t: Well, let me think. I suppose the main reason is time.
examples.uz: Xo‘sh, o‘ylab ko‘ray. Menimcha, asosiy sabab vaqt.

examples.t: It was expensive, or rather, it was more than I had planned to spend.
examples.uz: Qimmat edi, to‘g‘rirog‘i, rejalashtirganimdan ko‘p edi.

examples.t: I can’t remember the word, but it is a kind of tool for measuring temperature.
examples.uz: So‘zni eslay olmayapman, lekin bu haroratni o‘lchaydigan asbob.

scenes.say_native: Ravonlik tezlik degani emas, to‘xtamasdan davom eta olish. Birinchi usul: tabiiy to‘ldiruvchilar — „well“, „let me think“, „actually“. Ular o‘ylash vaqtini beradi va tabiiy eshitiladi, lekin juda ko‘p ishlatmang. Ikkinchi usul: o‘zingizni tuzatish — „or rather“, „what I mean is“. Bu xato emas, balki ravon so‘zlovchi odati. Uchinchi usul: so‘zni eslay olmasangiz, tushuntiring: „a kind of tool for measuring temperature“. Bu ibora „circumlocution“ deyiladi, ya’ni aylanib tushuntirish. O‘zbek tilidagi „ee“, „mana“ kabi to‘ldiruvchilar o‘rniga inglizcha „well“ va „you know“ ishlating, lekin „um“ ni cho‘zmang.
scenes.say: Fluency does not mean speed. It means being able to keep going. Use natural fillers such as well, let me think and actually, but not too many. Correct yourself smoothly: it was expensive, or rather, more than I had planned to spend. If you forget a word, explain it: a kind of tool for measuring temperature. This is called circumlocution.
scenes.say_uz: Ravonlik tezlik emas, davom eta olish. Well, let me think kabi tabiiy to‘ldiruvchilardan foydalaning, lekin ko‘p emas. O‘zingizni silliq tuzating. So‘zni unutsangiz, uni tushuntiring, buni aylanib tushuntirish deyiladi.

scenes.title: Xato: to‘xtab qolish va cho‘zish

examples.t: That is an interesting question. Let me think for a second.
examples.uz: Qiziq savol. Bir soniya o‘ylab ko‘ray.

examples.t: I tend to go to bed late, which is probably not ideal.
examples.uz: Men odatda kech yotaman, bu ehtimol yaxshi emas.

scenes.say_native: Eng katta xato — uzoq jimlik va „I don’t know“ deb to‘xtash. Imtihonda „bilmayman“ deyish ball keltirmaydi. O‘rniga: „That is an interesting question. Let me think for a second“, keyin „I suppose…“ bilan boshlang. Ikkinchi xato — „ummm“ ni cho‘zish: bu ishonchsizlik belgisi. Qisqa „well“ yoki „so“ bilan almashtiring. Uchinchi xato — hayajondan juda tez gapirish; natijada talaffuz buziladi. Sekin va aniq gapiring. „Tend to“ — odatda shunday qilmoq, tabiiy iborani ishlating: „I tend to go to bed late“. Siz o‘ylashga vaqt olishingiz mumkin, lekin so‘zlar bilan, jimlik bilan emas.
scenes.say: The biggest mistake is a long silence followed by I don't know. That earns nothing. Say instead: that is an interesting question, let me think for a second, and then start with I suppose. Do not drag out ummm. Use a short well or so. Do not rush because of nerves either. I tend to go to bed late is a natural phrase.
scenes.say_uz: Eng katta xato — uzoq jimlik va I don’t know. Buning o‘rniga: qiziq savol, bir soniya o‘ylab ko‘ray, deb I suppose bilan boshlang. Ummm ni cho‘zmang, qisqa well yoki so ishlating. Hayajondan shoshilmang.

scenes.title: Mashq: o‘zingizni tuzating
board: Describe your last holiday for 20 seconds.
scenes.say_native: Oxirgi ta’tilingizni yigirma soniya ichida tasvirlang. Nutqingizda bitta o‘zini tuzatish, masalan „or rather“, va bitta tabiiy to‘ldiruvchi, masalan „well“, bo‘lsin. To‘xtab qolmang. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Describe your last holiday for twenty seconds. Include one self-correction, such as or rather, and one natural filler, such as well. Keep going without long pauses.
scenes.say_uz: Oxirgi ta’tilingizni yigirma soniyada tasvirlang. Bitta o‘zini tuzatish, masalan or rather, va bitta tabiiy to‘ldiruvchi, masalan well, qo‘shing. Uzoq to‘xtamang.

scenes.title: Javob: ta’til namunasi
board: Well, my last holiday was in Samarkand…

examples.t: We stayed for three days, or rather four, because the weather was so pleasant.
examples.uz: Uch kun, to‘g‘rirog‘i to‘rt kun qoldik, chunki ob-havo juda yoqimli edi.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „Well, my last holiday was in Samarkand with my cousins. We stayed for three days, or rather four, because the weather was so pleasant. We spent most of the time wandering around the old streets, and the food was unforgettable.“ Bu yerda „well“ — to‘ldiruvchi, „or rather“ — o‘zini tuzatish. „Wander around“ — aylanib yurmoq, „unforgettable“ — unutilmas. Javob qisqa va tabiiy. E’tibor bering, o‘zini tuzatish ravonlikni buzmaydi, aksincha, tabiiy nutqni ko‘rsatadi. Sizning javobingizda ikkala vosita bo‘lsa va to‘xtamasdan davom etgan bo‘lsangiz, mashq bajarilgan.
scenes.say: A model answer. Well, my last holiday was in Samarkand with my cousins. We stayed for three days, or rather four, because the weather was so pleasant. We spent most of the time wandering around the old streets, and the food was unforgettable. The self-correction does not break fluency. It actually sounds natural.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. Xo‘sh, oxirgi ta’tilim amakivachchalarim bilan Samarqandda bo‘ldi. Uch kun, to‘g‘rirog‘i to‘rt kun qoldik, chunki ob-havo juda yoqimli edi. Ko‘p vaqtni qadimiy ko‘chalarda aylanib o‘tkazdik va taomlar unutilmas edi. O‘zini tuzatish ravonlikni buzmaydi, tabiiy eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Javobni kengaytirish
board: Extend with: because · for instance · which means
Add contrast: although · on the other hand

examples.t: I enjoy cooking because it helps me relax, which is important after a long day.
examples.uz: Ovqat pishirishni yoqtiraman, chunki bu dam olishga yordam beradi, bu uzoq kundan keyin muhim.

examples.t: For instance, last Sunday I made plov for twelve people.
examples.uz: Masalan, o‘tgan yakshanba o‘n ikki kishiga palov pishirdim.

examples.t: Although it takes time, it is worth it.
examples.uz: Vaqt olsa-da, bunga arziydi.

scenes.say_native: Javobni kengaytirishning eng oddiy yo‘li — PREP: Point, Reason, Example, Point. Avval javob: „I enjoy cooking“. Keyin sabab: „because it helps me relax“. Keyin misol: „For instance, last Sunday I made plov for twelve people“. Oxirida qisqa xulosa: „So it is something I always look forward to“. Qo‘shimcha ravishda „which means“ — bu esa degani, ma’noni kengaytiradi, „although“ va „on the other hand“ esa qarama-qarshilik beradi. Maqsad: uch-besh gap, bitta emas. O‘zbek madaniyatida katta odam savolidan keyin qisqa javob odobli hisoblanadi, imtihonda esa imtihonchi sizning tilingizni baholash uchun ko‘proq gap kutadi.
scenes.say: The simplest way to extend an answer is PREP: point, reason, example, point. I enjoy cooking, because it helps me relax, which is important after a long day. For instance, last Sunday I made plov for twelve people. Add a contrast with although or on the other hand. Aim for three to five sentences, not one.
scenes.say_uz: Javobni kengaytirishning eng oddiy yo‘li — PREP: fikr, sabab, misol, fikr. Ovqat pishirishni yoqtiraman, chunki dam olishga yordam beradi. Masalan, o‘tgan yakshanba o‘n ikki kishiga palov pishirdim. Although yoki on the other hand bilan qarama-qarshilik qo‘shing. Bitta emas, uch-besh gap ayting.

scenes.title: Mashq: javobni kengaytiring
board: Q: Do you like using public transport?
Use PREP: point · reason · example · point
scenes.say_native: Savol: jamoat transportidan foydalanishni yoqtirasizmi? PREP bo‘yicha javob bering: fikr, sabab, misol va qisqa xulosa. Yigirma besh soniya gapiring. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: The question is: do you like using public transport? Answer using PREP: a point, a reason, an example and a short closing point. Speak for about twenty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Savol: jamoat transportidan foydalanishni yoqtirasizmi? PREP bo‘yicha javob bering: fikr, sabab, misol va qisqa yakun. Taxminan yigirma besh soniya gapiring.

scenes.title: Javob: PREP namunasi
board: R: it is cheaper and avoids traffic jams
E: the metro takes me to work in 20 minutes

examples.t: The metro takes me to work in twenty minutes, whereas driving can take an hour.
examples.uz: Metro meni ishga yigirma daqiqada yetkazadi, mashinada esa bir soat ketishi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „Generally, yes. It is much cheaper than driving, and it avoids the traffic jams. For example, the metro takes me to work in twenty minutes, whereas driving can take an hour. So on weekdays I definitely prefer it.“ Birinchi gap fikr, ikkinchisi sabab, uchinchisi misol, to‘rtinchisi yakun. „Whereas“ — holbuki, ikkita narsani solishtiradi. „Generally“ — odatda, umuman. To‘rt gap yigirma besh soniyaga mos keladi. Siz boshqa sabab ham keltirishingiz mumkin, masalan ekologiya yoki qulaylik; muhimi, misol bo‘lsin va javob bitta gapdan ko‘p bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: A model answer. Generally, yes. It is much cheaper than driving, and it avoids the traffic jams. For example, the metro takes me to work in twenty minutes, whereas driving can take an hour. So on weekdays I definitely prefer it. Point, reason, example, point, in four sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. Umuman, ha. U mashinadan ancha arzon va tirbandlikdan qutqaradi. Masalan, metro meni ishga yigirma daqiqada yetkazadi, mashinada esa bir soat ketishi mumkin. Shuning uchun ish kunlari uni albatta afzal ko‘raman. Fikr, sabab, misol, yakun, to‘rt gapda.

scenes.title: Part 2: uzun nutq
board: Cover every bullet on the card

examples.t: I would like to talk about a teacher who influenced me greatly.
examples.uz: Menga katta ta’sir qilgan o‘qituvchi haqida gapirmoqchiman.

examples.t: What I remember most is the way she made difficult ideas simple.
examples.uz: Eng ko‘p esimda qolgani — u qiyin g‘oyalarni qanday oddiy qilishi.

examples.t: Looking back, I realise how much I owe her.
examples.uz: Ortga qarasam, unga qanchalik qarzdor ekanimni anglayman.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi qism — eng qiyin, chunki bir-ikki daqiqa yolg‘iz gapirasiz. Bir daqiqa tayyorgarlikda to‘liq gap yozmang, faqat kalit so‘zlar yozing. Kartochkadagi hamma savollarga javob bering. Yaxshi tuzilma: „I would like to talk about…“, keyin voqea, keyin sababi, oxirida his-tuyg‘u: „Looking back, I realise how much I owe her“. „What I remember most is…“ — eng esimda qolgani. Imtihonchi to‘xtatmaguncha davom eting; agar fikringiz tugab qolsa, yana bitta tafsilot qo‘shing: ob-havo, hid, ovoz. O‘zbek tilida hikoya qilish odati bu yerda foyda beradi, shunchaki fakt emas, hikoya qiling.
scenes.say: Part Two is the hardest, because you speak alone for one to two minutes. In your preparation minute, write keywords only. Cover every bullet on the card. A good structure: I would like to talk about a teacher who influenced me greatly, then the story, then why. Close with a feeling: looking back, I realise how much I owe her. Keep going until the examiner stops you.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkinchi qism eng qiyin, chunki bir-ikki daqiqa yolg‘iz gapirasiz. Tayyorgarlikda faqat kalit so‘zlar yozing. Kartochkadagi hamma banddga javob bering. Yaxshi tuzilma: nima haqida gapirasiz, voqea, sabab va his-tuyg‘u bilan yakun. Imtihonchi to‘xtatmaguncha davom eting.

scenes.title: Xato: kartochkani chetlab o‘tish
board: ✓ Adapt a real story to the card

examples.t: I will adapt a story I know well to fit the card.
examples.uz: Yaxshi biladigan hikoyamni kartochkaga moslayman.

examples.t: One more detail is that the room smelled of old books.
examples.uz: Yana bitta tafsilot: xonadan eski kitoblar hidi kelardi.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi qismdagi xatolarni sanaymiz. Birinchi: kartochkadagi bandlardan birini tashlab ketish. Har bir banddagi savolga javob bering, chunki bu mazmun mezoniga ta’sir qiladi. Ikkinchi: boshqa mavzuda yodlagan hikoyani ishlatish. Imtihonchi buni sezadi, shuning uchun haqiqiy hikoyani kartochkaga moslang. Uchinchi: qirq soniyada to‘xtab qolish. Agar gapingiz tugagan bo‘lsa, tafsilot qo‘shing: „One more detail is that the room smelled of old books“. Hid, ovoz, rang kabi sezgilar hikoyani jonlantiradi. Haqiqiy tajribangiz bo‘lmasa, to‘qib chiqarishingiz mumkin: imtihonda rost aytish shart emas.
scenes.say: Part Two has three typical errors. Skipping a bullet point. Each bullet is part of the task. Reciting a memorised story that does not fit. Examiners notice, so adapt a real story to the card. And stopping after forty seconds. If you run out of ideas, add a detail: one more detail is that the room smelled of old books. You may invent details. The exam tests language, not honesty.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkinchi qismda uchta xato bor. Bandni tashlab ketish. Mos kelmaydigan yodlangan hikoyani aytish. Qirq soniyada to‘xtab qolish; fikr tugasa, tafsilot qo‘shing. Tafsilotlarni to‘qish mumkin, imtihon tilni tekshiradi, rostlikni emas.

scenes.title: Mashq: bir daqiqalik nutq
board: Describe a useful skill you learned.
You should say: what it is · how you learned it · why it is useful
scenes.say_native: Kartochka: o‘rgangan foydali ko‘nikmangizni tasvirlang. Ayting: u nima, qanday o‘rgandingiz va nega foydali. Oltmish soniya to‘xtamasdan gapiring, uchala bandni qoplang. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Describe a useful skill you have learned. You should say what it is, how you learned it and why it is useful. Speak for sixty seconds without stopping, and cover all three points.
scenes.say_uz: O‘rgangan foydali ko‘nikmangizni tasvirlang. Ayting: u nima, qanday o‘rgandingiz va nega foydali. Oltmish soniya to‘xtamasdan, uchala bandni qoplab gapiring.

scenes.title: Javob: Part 2 namunasi

examples.t: I would like to talk about touch typing, which has saved me countless hours.
examples.uz: Ko‘r-ko‘rona terish haqida gapirmoqchiman, u menga son-sanoqsiz soat tejadi.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „I would like to talk about touch typing, which has saved me countless hours. I learned it three years ago through a free online course, practising for fifteen minutes every morning. It was frustrating at first, but gradually my speed doubled. It is useful because I write reports every day, and I make far fewer mistakes now.“ „Countless“ — son-sanoqsiz, „gradually“ — asta-sekin, „frustrating“ — asabiylashtiradigan. Uchala band bor: nima, qanday, nega. Birinchi gapda mavzu, so‘ng tajriba, keyin foyda. Sizning javobingizda bandlar qoplangan bo‘lsa, topshiriq bajarilgan.
scenes.say: A model answer. I would like to talk about touch typing, which has saved me countless hours. I learned it three years ago through a free online course, practising for fifteen minutes every morning. It was frustrating at first, but gradually my speed doubled. It is useful because I write reports every day, and I make far fewer mistakes now.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. Ko‘r-ko‘rona terish haqida gapirmoqchiman, u menga son-sanoqsiz soat tejadi. Uch yil oldin bepul onlayn kurs orqali o‘rgandim, har ertalab o‘n besh daqiqa mashq qilib. Avval asabiylashtirdi, lekin asta-sekin tezligim ikki baravar oshdi. Har kuni hisobot yozaman va endi ancha kam xato qilaman.

scenes.title: Notanish mavzu va Part 3
board: Buy time: That’s not something I’ve thought about much, but…
Speculate: I imagine · I’d guess · it could be that…
Generalise: in my country · many people

examples.t: That’s not something I have thought about much, but I would guess that it depends on age.
examples.uz: Bu haqda ko‘p o‘ylamaganman, lekin yoshga bog‘liq bo‘lsa kerak deb taxmin qilaman.

examples.t: I imagine that in the future, more people will work from home.
examples.uz: Kelajakda ko‘proq odam uydan ishlaydi deb tasavvur qilaman.

examples.t: In my country, many people still prefer paying in cash.
examples.uz: Mening yurtimda ko‘pchilik hali ham naqd pulda to‘lashni afzal ko‘radi.

scenes.say_native: Notanish mavzuda hamma mutaxassis bo‘lishi shart emas. Imtihon sizning fikringizni emas, tilingizni baholaydi. Birinchi usul: vaqt yutish — „That’s not something I’ve thought about much, but…“. Ikkinchi usul: taxmin — „I imagine…“, „I would guess that…“, „it could be that…“. Uchinchi usul: umumlashtirish va o‘z yurtingiz tajribasi — „In my country, many people…“. To‘rtinchi usul: o‘tmish va kelajakni solishtirish. Uchinchi qismda savollar mavhum: „Why do people…?“, „How might this change?“ Siz sabab, oqibat va taxmin tilidan foydalanasiz. Faktni bilmasangiz, o‘z tasavvuringizni gapiring; hech kim sizni noto‘g‘ri deb jarimaga tortmaydi.
scenes.say: On an unfamiliar topic, you do not need to be an expert. The exam tests your language, not your knowledge. First, buy time: that's not something I have thought about much, but. Then speculate: I imagine, I would guess that, it could be that. You can also generalise: in my country, many people. And compare past and future. If you do not know the facts, share your impressions.
scenes.say_uz: Notanish mavzuda mutaxassis bo‘lish shart emas, imtihon tilni baholaydi. Vaqt yuting, keyin taxmin qiling: I imagine, I would guess that. O‘z yurtingiz tajribasini umumlashtiring va o‘tmish bilan kelajakni solishtiring. Faktlarni bilmasangiz, taassurotingizni ayting.

scenes.title: Xato: bilmayman deb to‘xtash
board: ✓ I’m not an expert, but I’d say…

examples.t: I am not an expert, but I would say that cost is the main factor.
examples.uz: Men mutaxassis emasman, lekin asosiy omil narx deyman.

examples.t: Could you repeat the question, please?
examples.uz: Savolni takrorlay olasizmi, iltimos?

scenes.say_native: Notanish mavzuda uchta xato bor. Birinchisi — „I know nothing about this“ deb to‘xtash. Bunday javob til imkoniyatingizni ko‘rsatmaydi. Yaxshisi: „I am not an expert, but I would say that cost is the main factor“. Ikkinchisi — mavzuni o‘zgartirib, tanish narsa haqida gapirish; imtihonchi savolga javob kutadi. Uchinchisi — savolni noto‘g‘ri tushunib, boshqa narsa haqida gapirish. Agar tushunmasangiz, „Could you repeat the question, please?“ deb so‘rang; bu yo‘l qo‘yiladi. Lekin ko‘p so‘ramang. Savol tushunarsiz bo‘lsa, so‘zni o‘zingiz tushuntiring: „Do you mean…?“ — nazarda tutganingiz shumi?
scenes.say: Three mistakes on unfamiliar topics. Saying I know nothing about this and stopping. Say: I am not an expert, but I would say that cost is the main factor. Changing the subject to something familiar. And answering a different question. If you did not hear the question, it is fine to ask: could you repeat the question, please? But do not do it too often.
scenes.say_uz: Notanish mavzuda uchta xato: I know nothing deb to‘xtash, mavzuni o‘zgartirish va boshqa savolga javob berish. Savolni eshitmasangiz, uni takrorlashni so‘rash mumkin, lekin tez-tez emas.

scenes.title: Mashq: notanish savol
board: Examiner: How might space tourism change society?
Use: buy time + speculate + one example
scenes.say_native: Imtihonchi so‘raydi: kosmik turizm jamiyatni qanday o‘zgartirishi mumkin? Bu haqda ko‘p bilmasangiz ham, vaqt yuting, taxmin qiling va bitta misol ayting. Yigirma besh soniya gapiring. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: The examiner asks: how might space tourism change society? Even if you know little, buy time, speculate and add one example. Speak for about twenty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihonchi so‘raydi: kosmik turizm jamiyatni qanday o‘zgartirishi mumkin? Kam bilsangiz ham, vaqt yuting, taxmin qiling va bitta misol qo‘shing. Taxminan yigirma besh soniya gapiring.

scenes.title: Javob: taxmin qilish

examples.t: I would imagine that it could create new jobs, although the cost would limit it to the wealthy.
examples.uz: Bu yangi ish o‘rinlari yaratishi mumkin, lekin narx uni boylar bilan cheklaydi deb tasavvur qilaman.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „That is a tough one, but I would imagine it could create entirely new industries, such as training and equipment. For example, small companies might offer preparation courses for travellers. On the other hand, the cost would probably limit it to the wealthy, so it may not affect ordinary people for a long time.“ Bu yerda „a tough one“ — qiyin savol, „would imagine“ — tasavvur qilaman, „entirely“ — butunlay, „might“ va „may“ — ehtimol. Taxmin uchun modal fe’llar juda mos. Javob faktlarni bilishni talab qilmadi, balki mantiqiy fikr yuritdi. Shu tarzda gapirsangiz, mavzu notanish bo‘lsa ham yuqori ball olasiz.
scenes.say: A model answer. That is a tough one, but I would imagine it could create entirely new industries, such as training and equipment. For example, small companies might offer preparation courses for travellers. On the other hand, the cost would probably limit it to the wealthy, so it may not affect ordinary people for a long time. Modal verbs are ideal for speculation.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. Bu qiyin savol, lekin butunlay yangi sohalar, masalan tayyorgarlik va jihozlar sohasi paydo bo‘lishi mumkin deb tasavvur qilaman. Masalan, kichik kompaniyalar sayohatchilar uchun tayyorgarlik kurslarini taklif qilishi mumkin. Boshqa tomondan, narx uni ehtimol boylar bilan cheklaydi. Taxmin uchun modal fe’llar juda mos.

scenes.title: Dialog: Part 1 va 3
board: Listen: how does Aziza extend answers?
How does she handle the abstract question?
scenes.say_native: Endi imtihon suhbatini tinglang. Imtihonchi va nomzod Aziza. Tinglang: Aziza javoblarini qanday kengaytiradi va mavhum savolni qanday hal qiladi?
scenes.say: Examiner: Do you enjoy reading? Aziza: Yes, very much, mainly novels. I read for about an hour before bed, because it helps me switch off. Examiner: Why do some people read less nowadays? Aziza: Well, that is an interesting question. I would guess it is because of smartphones. People are used to short videos, so a long book may feel too slow. On the other hand, audiobooks might bring some readers back.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihonchi: Kitob o‘qishni yoqtirasizmi? Aziza: Ha, juda, asosan romanlarni. Yotishdan oldin bir soat o‘qiyman, chunki bu ruhiy dam olishga yordam beradi. Imtihonchi: Nega ba’zi odamlar bugun kamroq o‘qiydi? Aziza: Xo‘sh, qiziq savol. Menimcha, smartfonlar sabab. Odamlar qisqa videolarga o‘rganib qolgan, shuning uchun uzun kitob juda sekin tuyulishi mumkin. Boshqa tomondan, audiokitoblar ba’zi o‘quvchilarni qaytarishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Mashq: dialogni tahlil qiling
board: 1) How does Aziza extend her first answer?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Aziza birinchi javobini qanday kengaytiradi? Ikkinchi: qaysi ibora vaqt yutishga yordam beradi? Uchinchi: u qanday qarama-qarshilik qo‘shadi? Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Answer three questions. How does Aziza extend her first answer? Which phrase buys her time? What contrast does she add at the end?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savolga javob bering. Aziza birinchi javobini qanday kengaytiradi? Qaysi ibora unga vaqt yutdiradi? Oxirida qanday qarama-qarshilik qo‘shadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: Aziza
board: 1) reason: it helps me switch off
2) Well, that is an interesting question
3) On the other hand, audiobooks might bring readers back

examples.t: It helps me switch off before bed.
examples.uz: Bu yotishdan oldin ruhiy dam olishga yordam beradi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: Aziza „because it helps me switch off“ deb sabab qo‘shdi. „Switch off“ — ruhan o‘chmoq, dam olmoq. Ikkinchi: vaqt yutish uchun „Well, that is an interesting question“ dedi. Uchinchi: „On the other hand, audiobooks might bring some readers back“ deb qarama-qarshilik qo‘shdi. Uchinchi qismda u „I would guess“ bilan taxmin qildi va „might“ bilan ehtiyotkor bo‘ldi. Shuningdek u sabab va oqibatni ko‘rsatdi: smartfonlar, qisqa videolar, shuning uchun uzun kitob sekin. Bu tuzilma har qanday mavhum savolga mos keladi.
scenes.say: One: she adds a reason, because it helps me switch off. Two: she buys time with well, that is an interesting question. Three: she adds a contrast, on the other hand, audiobooks might bring some readers back. In Part Three she also speculates with I would guess, uses might to be careful and shows cause and effect: smartphones, short videos, so a long book feels slow.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: u sabab qo‘shadi, bu ruhiy dam olishga yordam beradi. Ikki: well, qiziq savol deb vaqt yutadi. Uch: boshqa tomondan, audiokitoblar o‘quvchilarni qaytarishi mumkin deb qarama-qarshilik qo‘shadi. Uchinchi qismda taxmin qiladi, might bilan ehtiyot bo‘ladi va sabab-oqibatni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Dialog: sherik bilan muhokama
board: Cambridge style: two candidates discuss and decide
Listen: how do they invite each other?
How do they reach a decision?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog — Cambridge uslubidagi juftlikdagi muhokama. Ikki nomzod shahar markazi uchun eng yaxshi loyihani tanlaydi. Tinglang: ular bir-birini qanday gapirishga undaydi va qanday qarorga keladi?
scenes.say: Rustam: Shall we start with the park? What do you think? Mina: I like it, because families could use it every day. But what about the library? Rustam: Good point. It would help students, although it is expensive. Mina: True. Perhaps we could choose the park, and ask for funding for a small reading corner. Rustam: That sounds like a sensible compromise. Shall we agree on that?
scenes.say_uz: Rustam: Parkdan boshlaymizmi? Sizningcha qanday? Mina: Menga yoqadi, chunki oilalar undan har kuni foydalanishi mumkin. Lekin kutubxona-chi? Rustam: To‘g‘ri aytdingiz. U talabalarga yordam beradi, garchi qimmat. Mina: To‘g‘ri. Ehtimol parkni tanlab, kichik o‘qish burchagiga mablag‘ so‘rarmiz. Rustam: Bu oqilona murosa eshitiladi. Shunga kelishamizmi?

scenes.title: Mashq: hamkorlikdagi suhbat
board: 1) How does Rustam invite Mina’s opinion?
2) Which phrase shows agreement before a new point?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Rustam Minaning fikrini qanday so‘raydi? Ikkinchi: yangi fikrdan oldin rozilikni qaysi ibora bildiradi? Uchinchi: yakuniy qaror nima? Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Answer three questions. How does Rustam invite Mina's opinion? Which phrase shows agreement before a new point? What is the final decision?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savolga javob bering. Rustam Minaning fikrini qanday so‘raydi? Qaysi ibora yangi fikrdan oldin rozilikni bildiradi? Yakuniy qaror nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar: sherik bilan suhbat
board: 3) The park, plus funding for a small reading corner

examples.t: Good point. It would help students, although it is expensive.
examples.uz: To‘g‘ri fikr. U talabalarga yordam beradi, garchi qimmat.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: Rustam „What do you think?“ deb so‘radi. Ikkinchi: „Good point“ va „True“ rozilikni bildiradi, ular bahsni sinishdan emas, rivojlantirishdan saqlaydi. Uchinchi: qaror — park, va kichik o‘qish burchagi uchun mablag‘ so‘rash. Cambridge da bu juda muhim: siz sherikning gapini tinglaysiz, unga javob berasiz va birga qarorga kelasiz. Yolg‘iz uzoq gapirish bu yerda ball keltirmaydi. „Shall we agree on that?“ — kelishamizmi? Bunday iboralar suhbatni yakunlaydi. „Compromise“ — murosa. Sherikning gapini bo‘lmang va uni ham gapirishga undang.
scenes.say: One: Rustam asks, what do you think? Two: good point and true show agreement and let the discussion develop. Three: they decide on the park, plus funding for a small reading corner. In Cambridge, listening to your partner and reaching a decision together matters. Speaking alone for a long time does not help. Do not interrupt, and invite your partner to speak.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Rustam what do you think deb so‘raydi. Ikki: good point va true rozilikni bildiradi va suhbatni rivojlantiradi. Uch: ular parkni va kichik o‘qish burchagiga mablag‘ so‘rashni tanlaydi. Cambridge da sherikni tinglash va birga qarorga kelish muhim. Gapini bo‘lmang, uni ham gapirishga undang.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: urg‘u, ohang va ritm
board: Stress content words: nouns · verbs · adjectives
Rising for lists, falling to finish
Chunk: group words into thought groups

examples.t: I’d like to talk about a time when I helped a friend.
examples.uz: Do‘stimga yordam bergan vaqtim haqida gapirmoqchiman.

examples.t: We bought bread, cheese, apples, and some tea.
examples.uz: Non, pishloq, olma va bir oz choy sotib oldik.

scenes.say_native: Talaffuz bahosi to‘rtdan bir qismni tashkil qiladi. Birinchi qoida: mazmunli so‘zlarga urg‘u bering — ot, fe’l, sifat. Yordamchi so‘zlar kuchsiz aytiladi: „of“ taxminan „əv“, „to“ taxminan „tə“, „and“ taxminan „ən“. Ikkinchi qoida: ro‘yxatda ovoz ko‘tariladi, oxirgi elementda pasayadi: „bread, cheese, apples, and some tea“. Uchinchi qoida: gapni ma’no bo‘laklariga bo‘ling, ya’ni „chunks“. Har bo‘lakdan keyin qisqa pauza qiling. O‘zbek tilida urg‘u ko‘pincha oxirgi bo‘g‘inda bo‘ladi, inglizchada esa urg‘u so‘zga qarab o‘zgaradi, shuning uchun yangi so‘zni lug‘atdan urg‘usi bilan o‘rganing.
scenes.say: Pronunciation is a quarter of the mark. Stress content words: nouns, verbs and adjectives. Small words are weak: of sounds like uv, to like tuh, and like un. In lists, your voice rises on each item and falls on the last: bread, cheese, apples, and some tea. Group your speech into thought groups and pause briefly between them.
scenes.say_uz: Talaffuz bahoning chorak qismi. Mazmunli so‘zlarga urg‘u bering. Kichik so‘zlar kuchsiz aytiladi. Ro‘yxatda ovoz ko‘tarilib, oxirgisida pasayadi. Nutqni ma’no bo‘laklariga bo‘ling va ular orasida qisqa pauza qiling.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: mini gapirish testi
board: Part 1: Do you enjoy cooking? (20 s)
Part 2: Describe a place you like to visit (60 s)
Part 3: Why do people travel more now? (25 s)
scenes.say_native: Mini testni bajaring. Birinchi qism: ovqat pishirishni yoqtirasizmi? Yigirma soniya. Ikkinchi qism: borishni yoqtiradigan joyni tasvirlang, oltmish soniya. Uchinchi qism: nega odamlar hozir ko‘proq sayohat qiladi? Yigirma besh soniya. Kengaytirish, ravonlik va taxmin usullarini ishlating. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Do a mini test. Part One: do you enjoy cooking? Twenty seconds. Part Two: describe a place you like to visit. Sixty seconds. Part Three: why do people travel more now? Twenty-five seconds. Use extending, fluency and speculation strategies.
scenes.say_uz: Mini testni bajaring. Birinchi qism: ovqat pishirishni yoqtirasizmi? Yigirma soniya. Ikkinchi qism: borishni yoqtiradigan joyni tasvirlang, oltmish soniya. Uchinchi qism: nega odamlar hozir ko‘proq sayohat qiladi? Yigirma besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javob: mini test namunasi
board: P1: Yes, quite a lot, because…
P2: lake near Tashkent · what, how, why

examples.t: I would guess that cheaper flights and social media have made travel more tempting.
examples.uz: Arzon reyslar va ijtimoiy tarmoqlar sayohatni jozibador qilgan deb taxmin qilaman.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi qism: „Yes, quite a lot, because it helps me unwind, and on Sundays I cook for the whole family.“ Ikkinchi qism: „I would like to talk about a lake near Tashkent. I first went there as a child, and I still go every summer. I like it because it is quiet and the water is clear.“ Uchinchi qism: „I would guess that cheaper flights and social media have made travel more tempting. People see photos and want to experience places themselves.“ „Unwind“ — dam olmoq, „tempting“ — jozibador. Har qismda boshqacha uslub ishlatilgan: qisqa, hikoya va taxmin.
scenes.say: Model answers. Part One: yes, quite a lot, because it helps me unwind, and on Sundays I cook for the whole family. Part Two: I would like to talk about a lake near Tashkent. I first went there as a child, and I still go every summer, because it is quiet and the water is clear. Part Three: I would guess that cheaper flights and social media have made travel more tempting.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi qism: ha, ancha, chunki dam olishga yordam beradi va yakshanba kunlari butun oila uchun pishiraman. Ikkinchi qism: Toshkent yaqinidagi ko‘l haqida; bolaligimda borganman va hamon har yozda boraman, chunki sokin va suvi toza. Uchinchi qism: arzon reyslar va ijtimoiy tarmoqlar sayohatni jozibador qilgan deb taxmin qilaman.

scenes.title: Takrorlash
scenes.say_native: Bugungi darsni jamlaymiz. IELTS gapirish qismi uch bosqichdan iborat va to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha baholanadi. Aksent mukammal bo‘lishi shart emas, tushunarli nutq kerak. Javoblarni PREP bilan kengaytiring: fikr, sabab, misol, xulosa. Ravonlik uchun tabiiy to‘ldiruvchilar, o‘zini tuzatish va aylanib tushuntirishdan foydalaning. Ikkinchi qismda kartochkaning hamma bandini qoplang va to‘xtamang. Notanish mavzuda vaqt yuting va taxmin qiling. Cambridge da sherikni tinglang va birga qarorga keling. Talaffuzda mazmunli so‘zlarga urg‘u bering.
scenes.say: Let's review. IELTS Speaking has three parts and four criteria. You do not need a perfect accent, only clear speech. Extend answers with PREP. For fluency, use natural fillers, self-correction and circumlocution. In Part Two, cover every bullet and keep going. On unfamiliar topics, buy time and speculate. In Cambridge, listen to your partner and decide together.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlaymiz. IELTS Speaking uch qism va to‘rt mezondan iborat. Mukammal aksent kerak emas, aniq nutq kerak. Javobni PREP bilan kengaytiring. Ravonlik uchun to‘ldiruvchilar, o‘zini tuzatish va aylanib tushuntirishdan foydalaning. Ikkinchi qismda hamma bandni qoplang. Notanish mavzuda vaqt yuting va taxmin qiling. Cambridge da sherik bilan birga qaror qiling.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Homework: record a full mock speaking test
Part 1: 4 questions · Part 2: 1–2 min · Part 3: 4 questions
Listen back: count fillers, check PREP
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: to‘liq soxta gapirish testini yozib oling. Birinchi qismda to‘rtta savol, ikkinchi qismda bir daqiqa tayyorlanib bir-ikki daqiqalik nutq, uchinchi qismda yana to‘rtta mavhum savol. Hammasini taxminan o‘n daqiqada bajaring. Keyin yozuvni tinglang: uzoq jimliklarni, „um“ larni va PREP tuzilmasini tekshiring. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: ikkinchi qism kamida bir daqiqa to‘xtamasdan davom etgan, uchinchi qismda kamida ikkita taxminiy ibora ishlatilgan. Keyingi darsda professional portfolio va karyera rejasini tuzamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to record a full mock speaking test: four questions in Part One, a one to two minute talk in Part Two, and four abstract questions in Part Three. Then listen back. Check for long pauses, fillers and your PREP structure. Next time we build a professional portfolio and a career plan.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: to‘liq soxta gapirish testini yozib oling. Birinchi qismda to‘rtta savol, ikkinchi qismda bir-ikki daqiqalik nutq, uchinchi qismda to‘rtta mavhum savol. Keyin tinglang: uzoq pauzalar, to‘ldiruvchilar va PREP tuzilmasini tekshiring. Keyingi safar professional portfolio va karyera rejasini tuzamiz.

homework_uz: To‘liq soxta gapirish testini yozib oling: 1-qism (4 savol), 2-qism (kartochka, 1–2 daqiqa), 3-qism (4 mavhum savol). Yozuvni tinglab, uzoq jimliklar va to‘ldiruvchilarni sanang. 2-qism to‘xtamasdan davom etsin, 3-qismda kamida ikkita taxminiy ibora bo‘lsin. Keyingi darsda portfolio va karyera rejasini tuzamiz.

quiz.q: How long is Part 2 speaking of IELTS (after preparation)?
quiz.why_uz: Part 2 da bir-ikki daqiqa yolg‘iz gapirasiz.

quiz.q: Which is NOT an IELTS Speaking criterion?
Which answer is better in Part 1?
options: Yes, quite a lot, mainly because it keeps me active.
I like it because I like it.

quiz.q: You forget a word. What should you do?
options: Explain it: a kind of tool for measuring temperature
That’s an interesting question. Let me think.

quiz.q: Which phrase is best for speculating?
In Cambridge pair tasks, what is important?
options: Listening and reaching a decision together

quiz.q: How is ‘of’ usually pronounced in fast speech?
quiz.why_uz: Yordamchi so‘zlar tez nutqda kuchsiz aytiladi.

quiz.q: What should you do in Part 2 if you run out of ideas?
